q-0459.answer:
Surah Ghafir (40) — The Forgiver · 85 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• They will dwell therein forever, because of their great sin, which is associating others in worship with Allah.
• On the Day of Resurrection the victory will be greater and more complete.
• The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
• The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination.
• You invite me to disbelieve in Allah and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0598.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (84) — The Splitting Open · 25 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Splitting the Heavens asunder and stretching the Earth forth on the Day of Resurrection
• Inform them, O Muhammad, that Allah has prepared for them a painful torment.
• The Recompense for Deeds is True
• From their mannerism is rejection, obstinacy, and opposition to the truth.
• Certainly Allah will repeat his creation just as he began his creation, and He will reward him based upon his deeds, whether they were good or bad.

Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (84) — The Splitting Open · 25 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Splitting the Heavens asunder and stretching the Earth forth on the Day of Resurrection
• Inform them, O Muhammad, that Allah has prepared for them a painful torment.
• The Recompense for Deeds is True
• From their mannerism is rejection, obstinacy, and opposition to the truth.
• Certainly Allah will repeat his creation just as he began his creation, and He will reward him based upon his deeds, whether they were good or bad.
